description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface and filters log messages to only pass along the message content, omitting metadata for simplified log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements LogNode, passing only log messages to the next node in the chain, ignoring tags, priorities, and exceptions.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor accepting a LogNode to chain logging nodes.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: The subsequent LogNode to forward logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters incoming log messages to only pass the message content to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log messages are forwarded.
